d:
The Hawks defeated the Pistons, 107-97 tonight in Atlanta. Nickeil Alexander-Walker finished with a team-high 27 points along with 6 three pointers and 2 rebounds for the Hawks, while Corey Kispert tallied 18 points, 4 rebounds and 4 three pointers in the game. Isaiah Joe recorded 19 points, 3 steals and 3 assists. The Hawks improve their record to 11-6 with the win, while the Pistons fall to 10-6 for the season.
